assurance_contract.scope: Source-pinned pressure test of emergency mandate limitation, review, termination and remedy requirements; no observed jurisdictional deployment is implied.
assurance_contract.non_scope: No claims of national, implementation, legal, specialist or independent conformity without attributable operational evidence.
assurance_propositions: Emergency authority is bounded by scope, duration and review with effective termination.
Affected-party recourse and accountable effects remain observable when an emergency mandate expires or is withdrawn.
scenarios: expired or revoked emergency authority replay

actions.action: Obtain independently inspectable jurisdictional adoption evidence and negative traces for enforcement, expiry, revocation, review and remedy.
actions.acceptance_criterion: Both ONDTF-0001-R1 and ONDTF-0001-R2 cite attributable implementation-level positive and negative evidence before a new assurance determination.
